On Sun, May 9, 2026 at 1:28 PM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I looked at the event and it appears the organizer attribute on the ICS was rewritten by an automated calendar bridge...

This is likely the calendar federation proxy that FinServe's IT runs. When an invite is proxied through their conference ops mailbox the ORGANIZER field sometimes gets replaced, which strips Meet links for guests. We're seeing this with a couple of clients who have similar forwarding rules.

Short term options:
- Recreate the event in Google Calendar and make sure the organizer is irene@redwood.ai (don't forward).
- Create a Zoom meeting under redwood-infra@redwood.ai and send that invite (Zoom links are resilient when proxied).

I've attached a short diagnostic export from our outbound calendar service (support-log.txt) that shows the proxy rewrite. If you want, I can create the Zoom link and post it here; Irene can then send a fresh invite that we know won't be rewritten.

-- Alex Martinez
Platform Reliability Engineer
